description: ONIX, published by jlanversin, calculates nuclear depletion for reactor simulation and nuclear archaeology in Python 3, with coupling to OpenMC. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The README documents coupling with model-openmc for particle transport.
